title: Croydon Smoke
description: A swung 2-step garage groove carrying dubstep weight: a deep wobbling sub anchors gritty off-beat dub chord stabs while a chopped, pitched vocal flickers overhead. It hits an early peak then deconstructs into smoke and delay.
code:
setcpm(133/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.9).shape(0.3),
    s("~ hh ~ hh").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).swingBy(0.18, 8).hpf(4000),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] ~ [ab2,c3,eb3] ~>").s("sawtooth").lpf(perlin.range(500,1100).slow(8)).crush(7).shape(0.3).gain(0.55).delay(".4:.16:.5").pan(0.4)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.95).shape(0.35),
    s("~ ~ sd ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.85).delay(".25:.12:.3"),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).swingBy(0.2, 8).hpf(5000).degradeBy(0.15),
    note("c1 ~ <eb1 c1> ~").s("triangle").lpf(perlin.range(300,900).slow(7)).gain(0.85).shape(0.2),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] ~ [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] ~>").s("sawtooth").lpf(perlin.range(700,1600).slow(6)).crush(6).shape(0.4).gain(0.55).delay(".4:.16:.5")
  )],
  [28, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.0).shape(0.4),
    s("~ ~ sd ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.9).delay(".25:.12:.3"),
    s("~ cp ~ [~ cp]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.6),
    s("hh(7,16,3)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.55).swingBy(0.22, 8).hpf(5500).degradeBy(0.2),
    s("~ oh ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.4).hpf(4000),
    note("c1 ~ <eb1 g1> ~").s("triangle").lpf(perlin.range(350,1100).slow(5)).gain(0.95).shape(0.25),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] ~ [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] ~ [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] ~ [g2,bb2,d3,f3] ~>").s("sawtooth").lpf(perlin.range(800,2000).slow(4)).crush(6).shape(0.45).gain(0.55).delay(".4:.16:.5").off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3)),
    s("think").chop(8).speed("<1 1.5 0.75 1>").slice(8, "0 2 4 6").gain(0.5).hpf(600).delay(".3:.18:.4").pan(0.6).sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.speed(2))
  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("~ ~ sd ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.7).delay(".5:.2:.6"),
    note("c1 ~ ~ ~").s("triangle").lpf(perlin.range(300,700).slow(6)).gain(0.8).shape(0.2),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3] [f2,ab2,c3] [g2,bb2,d3]>").s("swpad").lpf(perlin.range(400,1300).slow(8)).gain(0.55).delay(".5:.25:.5").vowel("<a o e>"),
    s("think").chop(8).speed("<0.75 1 0.5>").gain(0.45).hpf(700).delay(".5:.25:.6").pan(0.4)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.0).shape(0.4),
    s("~ ~ sd ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.9).delay(".25:.12:.3"),
    s("~ cp ~ [~ cp]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.6),
    s("hh(9,16,4)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.55).swingBy(0.22, 8).hpf(6000).degradeBy(0.2),
    s("~ rim ~ rim").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.4).every(4, x => x.ply(2)),
    note("c1 ~ <eb1 g1> <f1 ~>").s("triangle").lpf(perlin.range(400,1300).slow(4)).gain(0.95).shape(0.3),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] ~ [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] ~ [f2,ab2,c3,eb3] ~ [g2,bb2,d3,f3] ~>").s("sawtooth").lpf(perlin.range(900,2400).slow(4)).crush(5).shape(0.5).gain(0.55).delay(".4:.16:.5").every(4, x => x.rev()).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3)),
    s("think").chop(8).speed("<1 1.5 0.75 2>").slice(8, "0 3 5 6").gain(0.5).hpf(600).delay(".3:.18:.4").pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7))
  )],
  [14, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.85).shape(0.3),
    note("c1 ~ <eb1 ~> ~").s("triangle").lpf(perlin.range(300,800).slow(6)).gain(0.8).shape(0.2),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(perlin.range(500,900).slow(8)).crush(7).shape(0.3).gain(0.5).delay(".5:.25:.6"),
    s("think").chop(8).speed("<0.75 0.5>").gain(0.4).hpf(700).delay(".6:.3:.6").degradeBy(0.4)
  )]
)
